title: Deathmatch
description: Customizable plugin which holds players at the start, gives a 30 minute loot-gathering period, and teleports players together at the end
body:
Deathmatch is a plugin designed for “Minecraft but…” style challenges and survival-based PvP events. It allows you to run timed matches where players have a set time to gather resources and are then automatically teleported into a final deathmatch.

  **🧩 Commands**
- /deathmatch start — Start a match
- /deathmatch duration <min> <sec> <ms> — Set match duration (Default 30 minutes)
- /deathmatch info — View current timer settings

# **Features**
⏳ **Configurable Match Timer**
- Default duration is 30 minutes
- Adjustable via /deathmatch duration <minutes>

**🟢 Start System**
- /deathmatch start begins the match
- 5-second countdown with title display
- Players are frozen during countdown
- “BEGIN!” signal with sound and title

**📺 On-Screen Warnings**
- Title notifications at:
- 10 minutes remaining
- 5 minutes remaining
- 1 minute remaining
- - ⏱ Live Countdown HUD (Action bar displays seconds remaining during the final minute)

**🧊 Freeze Protection**
- Players cannot move during the starting countdown
- Movement resumes automatically when the match begins

**⚔️ Deathmatch Arena Teleport**
- Players are teleported to the world spawn location
- Spawn points are distributed in a circular formation
- ~15 block spacing between players
- Players face toward the center for immediate combat

**🏆 Winner Detection**
- Automatically detects the last remaining player
- Broadcasts winner announcement
- Displays title and plays victory sound
